# Bob's Detailing

> Premium mobile car detailing in Pittsburgh, PA and surrounding areas. Family-owned, 10+ years of experience, fully self-contained mobile setup, 5.0 star rated, 100% satisfaction guarantee.

## About

Bob's Detailing is a premier mobile car detailing service based in Cranberry Township, PA, serving the greater Pittsburgh metro area. We come directly to our customers' homes or offices with a fully self-contained mobile detailing rig — no need for the customer to provide water or power. Founded in 2024 by Bob, who has over a decade of detailing experience. Phone: (412) 925-8970. Email: bookings@bobsdetailingpgh.com. Hours: 8am to 6pm, Monday through Sunday.

## Services

- [Ceramic Coating](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/ceramic-coating.html): Multi-year hydrophobic paint protection, professionally applied at the customer's location. 2–5 year durability depending on package.
- [Paint Correction](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/paint-correction.html): Removes swirls, scratches, oxidation, and water spots through multi-stage machine polishing.
- [Interior Detailing](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/interior-detailing.html): Deep interior cleaning including steam sanitization, hot-water extraction, leather conditioning, and full vacuum.
- [Pet Hair Removal](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/pet-hair-removal.html): Specialty tools and techniques to remove pet hair embedded in carpets and upholstery.
- [Headlight Restoration](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/headlight-restoration.html): Multi-stage wet sanding and UV sealant to restore foggy or yellowed headlights to factory clarity.
- [Maintenance Detail](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/maintenance-detail.html): Quick monthly refresh for well-kept vehicles. Available as a subscription via the Clean Car Club.

## Packages

- Daily Driver: Starting at $175 — full hand wash, quick protectant, complete vacuum, and interior reset.
- Bob's Signature (Most Popular): Starting at $275 — deep reset with paint decontamination, hand wax, full shampoo and extraction.
- Showroom Shine: Starting at $350 — premium synthetic sealant, hydrophobic protection, leather UV seal, and steam sanitization.

## Subscriptions

- Maintain: Monthly maintenance detailing for individuals.
- Signature Club: Recurring premium service with member perks.
- Showroom VIP: Full-service VIP plan with priority scheduling.
- Fleet plans available for businesses and dealerships.

## Service Areas

- [Pittsburgh, PA](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/pittsburgh.html): All Pittsburgh neighborhoods including Shadyside, Squirrel Hill, Lawrenceville, the Strip, Mt. Washington, and the South Side.
- [Cranberry Township, PA](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/cranberry-township.html): Our home base. Same-day or next-day availability.
- [Wexford, PA](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/wexford.html): Treesdale, Chadwick, and the broader 15090 zip code.
- [Sewickley, PA](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/sewickley.html): Sewickley, Sewickley Heights, Edgeworth, and the Quaker Valley.
- [Mt. Lebanon, PA](https://www.bobsdetailingpgh.com/mt-lebanon.html): All Mt. Lebanon neighborhoods including Beverly Heights, Virginia Manor, Mission Hills, and Hoodridge.
- We also serve: Allison Park, Bethel Park, Coraopolis, Robinson Township, Mars, and the broader 30-mile radius around Pittsburgh.

## Differentiators

- Fully self-contained mobile setup — no water or electric needed from the customer.
- 10+ years of detailing experience.
- 5.0 star rated.
- 100% satisfaction guarantee — we make it right if you're not happy.
- Premium tools and materials: pressure washer with foam cannon, hot-water extractor, multi-stage polishing equipment, ceramic coating supplies.
- Comes to home, office, apartment, or any location with reasonable access.
